name: ribbon-hard
prompt: Create ONE isolated orange horizontal full-screen RIBBON STRIP for a mobile game difficulty entrance, transparent RGBA PNG. The reference is a rough layout mockup; use only orange palette and the long flat screen-spanning ribbon design. OUTPUT ONLY THE RIBBON, no bear, words, stars, lightning, sweep-glow or background. FINAL GEOMETRY: a straight horizontal PARALLELOGRAM, 1400x280 intended delivery canvas. Main cloth band roughly 250 px high. Both ends cleanly cut on a slant: each top corner lies about 60 px to the RIGHT of its corresponding bottom corner. Top and bottom edges straight, horizontal, parallel. All FOUR corners are crisp (only antialiasing, no rounding); NO semicircular ends, NO capsule, NO pill, NO button, NO raised bezel or thick extrusion. A flat, subtle fine plush textile ribbon, top bright orange #FFB547 grading vertically to orange-red #FF6A3D. One THIN highlight along the very top edge. Two fine white dashed stitch lines only along the upper and lower long edges. Underneath it is ONE same-shaped dark-orange #9C2F14 parallelogram shadow strip, shifted DOWN by about 20 final px, opacity about 60%; clean hard slanted silhouette, no blurred ground shadow. The white motif near EACH end is exactly TWO rightward chevrons made of round white bubbles: each chevron has exactly FIVE separate circles arranged as > (upper-left dot, upper-right dot, tip-right dot in middle, lower-right dot, lower-left dot). Thus TEN circles at left end and TEN circles at right end; no solid arrow lines, no connecting lines. Left group printed faintly, right group brighter. Keep the broad CENTER entirely clear of decorations and text for a separate title. Circle motifs small enough to fit fully inside the band and not touch the stitch lines. Premium clean detailed game art but relatively FLAT CLOTH, very restrained texture/light, not glossy inflated plastic. Squarely horizontal asset; the engine applies its upward 6-degree tilt later. Wide transparent composition showing the entire complete parallelogram including both slanted ends and translucent under-strip; no clipping.
